t0: The machines that run your steps. Add one, see who is online, or take one away.
t1: Keys for scripts, and how to connect an AI assistant.
t2: Whether the person who starts a run may approve it themselves.
t3: Rules every pipeline is held to before it deploys.
t4: Whether the secrets this server stores are encrypted at rest, and where the key is held.
t5: Who changed what, and when. Every sign-in and every change.
t6: Named settings you set once at a level, which flow down to everything below. A lock keeps one from being overridden.
t7: Everything an administrator sets up, with a guided set-up for each, kept with its history.
t8: Nothing here is needed to run a pipeline day to day. Each row is a place you may change things.
t9: The first-run walk-through: sign-in, the root key, a {runner}, Git hosting, importing repositories and a first pipeline. Skip any step and come back.
